categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in manufacturing and selling automotive parts, focusing on engine temperature management system (TMS) components, engine measurement sensors and switches (EMS), engineering plastic lightweight parts, and eco-friendly parts including battery modules and integrated thermal management modules for electric vehicles. It operates without formal business segment divisions but categorizes products into these main groups. The company also engages in export and overseas manufacturing activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced automotive component manufacturing technologies including electronic thermostat valves, sensors for temperature, vibration, and pressure measurement, and engineering plastics for lightweight parts. It develops integrated thermal management systems for internal combustion engines, electric vehicles, and fuel cell vehicles. Production methods include precision molding, assembly of sensor modules, and integration of electronic control units, supported by certifications such as ISO 9001, TS-16949, and innovation in materials like PPS composites and thermoelectric modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and global automotive manufacturers such as Hyundai-Kia, GM Korea, Hyundai Mobis, GM Global, Audi, and SK Innovation. The company serves OEM markets for new vehicle production, aftermarket (A/S) parts, and export markets. It targets both internal combustion engine vehicles and rapidly growing electric and fuel cell vehicle markets, with expanding sales in emerging markets like China, India, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing plants in Siheung, Gyeongju, and Okcheon. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in China (Tianjin), the United States (Alabama, Detroit), India (Andhra Pradesh), Malaysia, Hungary, and North Korea (Kaesong). Its sales and production footprint covers major automotive markets including North America, Europe, China, India, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a Tier 1 or Tier 2 supplier, manufacturing critical components such as sensors, valves, and plastic parts for integration into automotive systems. It supplies directly to OEMs and supports aftermarket and export channels, positioning itself as a key component manufacturer within the automotive parts supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding eco-friendly automotive parts, especially for electric and fuel cell vehicles, through development of integrated thermal management modules and battery pack components. The company invests heavily in R&D focused on improving thermal efficiency, durability, and lightweight materials, leveraging government-supported projects and collaborations. It emphasizes digital twin technology, neural network-based control algorithms, and advanced composite materials to maintain technological leadership and diversify product offerings.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of automotive parts and components to OEMs and aftermarket customers, both domestically and internationally. The company also earns income from exports and overseas manufacturing operations. Additional revenue streams include rental income from real estate holdings. The business model is product sales-based with a focus on volume growth and expanding into new markets and product categories.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a dominant position in the domestic market for engine cooling control parts with over 85% market share and approximately 40% share in engineering plastic parts. It competes globally with other automotive parts suppliers in the sensor, valve, and thermal management segments. Competitive factors include technological innovation, cost competitiveness, scale, and global customer relationships. The company faces increasing competition from Chinese suppliers and global consolidation trends in the automotive parts industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 634 billion KRW, representing an 11.23% increase from the previous year, with operating profit growth of 22.73%. Total assets stood at about 649 billion KRW, up 6.95% year-over-year. The company has shown recovery and growth since 2021 after a downturn linked to geopolitical issues affecting sales in China. It maintains a strong credit rating (AA-) and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core technological expertise in engine temperature control and thermal management systems, offering high-quality, reliable, and innovative automotive components. It differentiates through a strong domestic market leadership, advanced R&D capabilities, and a diversified product portfolio including eco-friendly vehicle parts. Its global manufacturing footprint and close collaboration with major OEMs enable it to provide tailored solutions that improve vehicle efficiency and comply with stringent environmental regulations.
